MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 115, December 31, 1947 ]
FIXING THE DATE OF ORGANIZATION AND THE TERRITORIAL JURISDICTION OF THE CITY OF
By virtue of the power conferred upon me by Republic Act No. 170, I, MANUEL ROXAS, President of the
Philippines, do hereby fix the first of January, nineteen hundred and forty-eight, as the date for the
organization of the City of Dagupan and qualification of the City Mayor and Members of the Municipal Board
appointed in accordance with section 88 of said Act. Unless the President shall hereafter order otherwise the
City of Dagupan shall, as provided in the first paragraph, section 2, of Republic Act No. 170, comprise the
present territorial jurisdiction of the municipality of Dagupan, Province of Pangasinan.
Any provisions of Executive Order No. 96, dated October 1, 1947, which are inconsistent herewith, are hereby
modified or amended accordingly.
Done at the City of Manila, this 31st day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
forty-seven, and of the Independence of the Philippines, the second.
(Sgd.) MANUEL ROXAS
President of the Philippines
By the President:
Acting Chief of the Executive Office
